rounds.q: On average, how many years does a Christmas tree take to grow?
rounds.why: A 6 to 7 foot tree can take as little as 4 years or as many as 15.
rounds.src: National Christmas Tree Association, Quick Tree Facts (current page, read 2026)
rounds.fun: Seven years of growing for one tree. Some need just 4, others up to 15!

rounds.q: What % of new US houses are built with a wood frame?
rounds.why: Concrete frames made up 5% of new houses, and steel just half a percent.
rounds.src: National Association of Home Builders analysis of Census Bureau Survey of Construction (2025 data)
rounds.fun: Wood frames hold up 94% of new houses. Steel gets just half a percent.

rounds.q: How many feet tall is the world's tallest living tree?
rounds.why: The redwood, named Hyperion, is 380 ft 9.7 in tall and thought to be 600 to 800 years old.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Tallest tree living (2019 measurement)
rounds.fun: Hyperion the redwood stands almost 381 feet tall after 600 to 800 years.

rounds.q: Maple sap is about 2% sugar. How many gallons boil down to 1 gallon of syrup?
rounds.why: The usual rule of thumb is 40 gallons. One tap gives just 10 to 12 gallons in a season.
rounds.src: University of Minnesota Extension, Homemade maple syrup (current page, read 2026)
rounds.fun: It takes 43 gallons of sap for 1 gallon of syrup. One tap gives just 10 to 12!

rounds.q: Methuselah is a pine tree in California. About how many years old is it?
rounds.why: Guinness lists it at 4,856 years as of 2024, based on tree ring samples first taken in 1957.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Oldest living individual tree (age as of 2024)
rounds.fun: Guinness puts Methuselah at 4,856 years old. Its rings were first sampled in 1957.
